-    // The instruct's encoding is exactly one vsetvli_helper setup of the
-    // required shape -- always m1/tu/mu, with vl taken from the shape's

-    // VL nor VTYPE and depend on no other vector configuration. Only instructs

+    // used by stores and reductions whose result is not a vector.
+    Flag_rvv_config_from_input = Node::_last_flag << 2,
+    // Set after explicit configuration nodes have been inserted. Before that,
+    // branch shortening must reserve space for a possible setup instruction.
+    Flag_rvv_config_processed = Node::_last_flag << 3,
+    _last_flag = Flag_rvv_config_processed

-// unchanged. Soundness rests on a port-wide invariant: any instruct whose
-// encoding programs VL/VTYPE (directly or through assembler helpers) must
-// leave mechanically visible vector evidence on its MachNode -- a vector
-// bottom_type, a vector-typed input, an allocated vector register, or a
-// vector register in a kill-projection mask. Conversely, a purely scalar
-// instruct -- scalar type, scalar registers, scalar inputs, no vector KILL
-// effect -- must never modify VL/VTYPE. Runtime and stub calls are covered
-// by has_call(), and vector spill copies select their RVV emission path on
-// the same bottom_type test used below, so both are classified correctly.
-// Preserve this invariant when adding instructs that inline RVV sequences
-// behind a scalar-only signature.
+// unchanged. Apart from the explicit rvv_set_config node handled below,
+// soundness rests on a port-wide invariant: any instruct whose encoding
+// programs VL/VTYPE (directly or through assembler helpers) must leave
+// mechanically visible vector evidence on its MachNode -- a vector
+// bottom_type, a vector-typed input, an allocated vector register, or a vector
+// register in a kill-projection mask. Conversely, a purely scalar instruct --
+// scalar type, scalar registers, scalar inputs, no vector KILL effect -- must
+// never modify VL/VTYPE. Runtime and stub calls are covered by has_call(), and
+// vector spill copies select their RVV emission path on the same bottom_type
+// test used below, so both are classified correctly. Preserve this invariant

-// Extended-basic-block elimination of redundant RVV vector configuration.
+static MachNode* rvv_make_config_node(BasicType bt, uint vl) {
+  rvv_set_configNode* config = new rvv_set_configNode();
+  // ADLC reserves operand zero for the absent result of an effect-only
+  // instruction. The two immediate USE operands follow it.
+  config->set_opnd_array(0, new UniverseOper());
+  config->set_opnd_array(1, new immIOper((jint)bt));
+  config->set_opnd_array(2, new immIOper((jint)vl));
+  return config;
+}
